title: 第21章 冲击高阶第22章 瀚海门
content_zh:
经过十几天的修炼，应无悔，终于感觉到可以冲击高阶。
异能满心景的五分之四，白色的异能能量，充斥在这个心中的世界当中，上面有一层薄膜，阻隔掉了异能能继续的吸收，必须突破这层膜，才能突破到高阶。
应无悔聚精会神，运起全身的异能，白色的能量在周遭流转，这次冲击高阶并没有他想象的那么简单。
心景中的异能，不断的冲击这层膜，这层膜拥有弹性，起伏较小的冲击根本不够冲开，所以不只有不断加大力度，那层膜也在渐渐的减小，冲击高阶，会大幅消耗体内的异能，以应无悔异能的容量，不足以一天将它冲开，只有用天数堆上去，坚持每天都冲击那层薄膜，才有可能突破到高阶。
今天应无悔体内的异能已经消耗殆尽，只有等明天。
循环往复五六天后，应无悔终于冲击到高阶，他感觉全身的力量再一次得到强化，他觉得自身更加轻盈有力。
冲击的过程并不轻松，感觉就像被千斤重鼎一直压着，循环往复，你要将千斤重鼎推开，让它不压在身上，这五六天搞的运会是形神俱疲，体内的异能全耗光了，看样子要两三天才能恢复。
应无悔运起异能，更多更加耀眼的白色异能在他身边旋转。
他又收起异能，知道异能变得比之前更多更明亮了。
“呼”
他长叹一口气，终于到达了高阶，功夫不负有心人！
狱火行者感受到这样的气息，立马从洞穴深处钻出，飞到应无悔身边。
“终于突破到高阶了，不枉老夫的大力栽培！”
狱火行者面带笑容的说道，“是的，终于可以给你解除这里的封印了，我都说我说到做到的”
“很好，休息几天，到时候帮我全力破开这里的封印！”
这次狩猎角狼的测试，最为期待的李典却只得到四根狼角，她也不藏着掖着，直接说中途遇到了黄毛山魈，被拖延住了时间。
所有人的目光都呆呆的看着她，什么？黄毛山魈，那可是一级异能高阶的异能兽！
换作是他们，可能非死即伤，可她却击杀了那只异能兽，可见她的实力是有多恐怖。
许多弟子反而变得不关心起狼角的数量，对于李典这样的事迹，他们认定，如果她不遇到黄毛山魈，本次狩猎大赛应该又是她第一吧。
最主要的是，黄毛山魈有异能丹，可以加快异能师的修炼，并且还有机会额外获得一个技能，这让他们十分嫉妒又十分羡慕。

“本次狩猎大赛排名公布！
焱傅韩第一名，二十五个狼角，焱梦葳，二十一个狼角，焱奔，十五个狼角……”
本次一到十名请到学堂事务处领取奖励。
焱奔是谁？像黑马一样，突然这个名字跳到大家面前，他之前也是炎门的本门弟子，二等天赋，他能这样优秀也是很正常的，毕竟和他的本门师兄弟比起来，也只能算是中等。
焱小昂在心里暗暗生气，这种坏事怎么能被自己碰上？每一次测试，都让自己不满意，为什么老天要这样限制自己？我不过是想超越个一等天赋的弟子，然而，一次又一次的接近，却仍然被前面那几个人甩得很远，差一点就是差很多，这一直成为我的心结，我必须要突破它。
可是怎么会现在还有人不认识我，我好歹也拿过学堂测试第六名！
content_en:
After more than ten days of practice, Ying Wu regretted that he finally felt that he could reach high levels.
Four-fifths of the scene where superpowers fill the heart, white superpower energy, fills the world in the heart. There is a thin film on it, blocking the continued absorption of superpowers. This film must be broken through to reach a high level.
Ying Wuhui concentrated his concentration and activated all his powers. White energy circulated around him. This time, the attack on the high level was not as simple as he thought.
The superpowers in the mind are constantly impacting this membrane. This membrane is elastic, and impacts with small fluctuations are simply not enough to break it open. Therefore, not only do we have to continuously increase the intensity, but the membrane is also gradually reduced. Impacting high levels will greatly consume the superpowers in the body. The capacity of the Wuhui superpower is not enough to break it open in one day. Only by piling it up for days and insisting on impacting the membrane every day can it be possible to break through to the high level.
Today, Ying Wuhui's powers have been exhausted and he can only wait for tomorrow.
After repeating the cycle for five or six days, Ying Wuhui finally reached the high level. He felt that the strength of his whole body was once again strengthened, and he felt that he was lighter and more powerful.
The process of impact is not easy. It feels like being pressed by a heavy cauldron. The cycle goes on and on. You have to push the heavy cauldron away so that it does not press on you. After these five or six days of sports, you are physically and mentally exhausted. All the superpowers in your body are used up. It seems that it will take two or three days to recover.
Ying Wuhui activated his powers, and more and more dazzling white powers were spinning around him.
He put away his powers again, knowing that his powers had become more abundant and brighter than before.
"Hoo"
He let out a long sigh and finally reached the high level. His hard work paid off!
The Hellfire Walker sensed this aura and immediately emerged from the depths of the cave and flew to Ying Wuhui's side.
"I finally broke through to a high level, and my hard work is not in vain!"
Hellfire Walker said with a smile, "Yes, I can finally lift the seal here for you. I said I will do what I said."
"Very good, rest for a few days, and then help me break the seal here with all your strength!"
In this test of hunting horned wolves, Li Dian, who was most looking forward to it, only got four wolf horns. She didn't hide them and just said that she encountered a yellow-haired mandrill in the middle, which was delayed.
Everyone looked at her blankly, what? The yellow-haired mandrill is a high-level supernatural beast with first-level powers!
If it were them, they would probably be dead or injured, but she killed the supernatural beast, which shows how terrifying her strength is.
Many disciples became unconcerned with the number of wolf horns. Regarding Li Dian's deeds, they concluded that if she had not encountered the yellow-haired mandrill, she would have ranked first in this hunting competition.
The most important thing is that the yellow-haired mandrill has a power pill that can speed up the training of a power master and also has the opportunity to obtain an additional skill, which makes them very jealous and envious.
"The rankings of this hunting competition are announced!
Yan Fuhan ranked first, with twenty-five wolf horns, Yan Mengwei, with twenty-one wolf horns, Yan Ben, with fifteen wolf horns..."
This time, one to ten people should go to the school affairs office to receive their rewards.
Who is Yan Ben? Like a dark horse, this name suddenly jumped out to everyone. He was also a disciple of Yan Clan before, with a second-level talent. It is normal for him to be so good. After all, compared with his fellow disciples, he can only be regarded as average.
Yan Xiaoang was secretly angry in his heart, how could such a bad thing happen to him? Every time I test, I am dissatisfied. Why does God restrict myself like this? I just want to surpass a first-class talented disciple. However, I get close again and again, but I am still far behind the few people in front of me. I am almost a lot behind. This has always been a knot in my heart, and I must break through it.
But how come there are still people who don’t know me now? I managed to get sixth place in the school test!
